newsitem.title: UK: Kellogg Europe account said worth 160 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Kellogg Europe account said worth 160 mln stg.

text.p: The media buying account that Kellogg Europe awarded to J. Walter Thompson (JWT) on Wednesday is worth 160 million stg ($261 million), Marketing Week magazine reported.
Kellogg Europe announced earlier it was consolidating its media buying into a newly-formed company that is part of JWT, after having previously used six different media buying agencies.

Marketing Week said Carat had been one of the six and had handled 20 percent of Kellogg Europe's media buying. The Carat Group of operating companies, Europe's leading media planning and buying network, is owned by Aegis Group Plc.

Kellogg Europe, part of U.S. based Kellogg Co, the world's largest cereal maker, said it consolidated its media buying into a newly-formed unit called Kellogg Europe Media, whose board members will include JWT and Kellogg managers. JWT is owned by WPP Group Plc.
"Consolidating all European media buying will facilitate more effective communication across our European operations," said Donald Fritz, president of Kellogg Europe.
It is not the first time that JWT has set up a new unit to handle a client's media buying.
In the U.S. Ford Motor Co consolidated its entire national $1.1 billion worth of media buying into a unit at JWT called Ford Motor Media.
Media buyers purchase advertising space and airtime on behalf of clients.
-- London Advertising Newsdesk +44 171 542 2792 ($ = 0.613 British Pounds Sterling)
